evidence: /products lists 9 products; each article exposes name (h3), category badge, price, rating value (e.g. 4.8), brief description, img, and an external purchase link (e.g. https://example.com/sony-xm5).
Each card has a "Buy Now" anchor with target=_blank rel=noopener to the product's own retailer URL; clicking Sony's opened new tab https://example.com/sony-xm5.

Category filter on /products: Tech Gadgets→3 (Samsung, MacBook, Sony), Home Goods→3 (Breville, Philips Hue, Dyson), Fitness→3 (Bowflex, Theragun, Peloton); count text updates to "3 products found" each time.

Sort price-asc gave 199→2495 ascending; price-desc gave 2495→199; Top Rated gave 4.9→4.4 descending; newest is default. Min rating 4.5+ reduced 9→8 (all ≥4.5). Dragging price slider set range $0–$1250 → 5 products, all ≤$1250.
Category, sort, min-rating and price-range changes all re-rendered the grid, order and "N products found" count instantly with no navigation/reload (URL stayed /products).

Tags wireless+coffee → 2 results (Sony has wireless, Breville has coffee: OR semantics, each result has ≥1 selected tag). Adding category=Tech narrowed to 1 (Sony), count "1 product found". Earlier rating≥4.5 and price ≤$1250 filters also only returned conforming products.

Search "SONY"→1 (name match), "EsPreSSo"→1 Breville, "FLAGSHIP"→1 Samsung (tag-only match), "CORDLESS VACUUM"→1 Dyson (description match). All case-insensitive; count text matched rendered card count each time.

/product/sony-wh-1000xm5 shows name "Sony WH-1000XM5", category badge Tech, rating 4.8, price $399, brief description, 446-char full review, 4 tags (headphones, wireless, noise-cancelling, premium), 5 specs (driver size, battery, weight, bluetooth, ANC), product image, and Buy Now action to https://example.com/sony-xm5.
Clicking the Sony card name on /products navigated to /product/sony-wh-1000xm5 showing that product; card image is wrapped in the same href="/product/sony-wh-1000xm5" anchor.

issue: Category selector on the category page is inert
actual: On /category/fitness the filter bar offers a category select (options All/Tech Gadgets/Home Goods/Fitness). Selecting "Home Goods" and then "Tech Gadgets" left everything unchanged: URL stayed /category/fitness, heading/category.name stayed "Fitness", the select still read "Fitness", and the grid still showed only Bowflex, Theragun, Peloton. On /products the same control works, so the failure is specific to category pages.

evidence: Peloton Bike+: homepage $2,495, category page Fitness/$2,495, products list Fitness/$2,495/4.6/"Premium connected fitness bike…", detail page identical name/category/price/rating/description plus full 462-char review and 5 specs shown untruncated (no line-clamp). Same consistency verified for Sony WH-1000XM5 ($399, Tech, 4.8).

Seeded tags are topically relevant: Sony WH-1000XM5 (Tech) → headphones, wireless, noise-cancelling, premium; Peloton Bike+ (Fitness) → cardio, cycling, smart-equipment, subscription; Samsung → flagship/smartphone; Breville (Home) → coffee/espresso. Category badge and tags match between list cards, tag filter facets and detail pages.
/product/does-not-exist-123 → "Product Not Found" message + Browse All Products link, 0 product cards. /category/bogus-cat → "Category Not Found", 0 product cards. No unrelated product data shown.

issue: Publish validation only checks name + short description; incomplete/invalid products are accepted
actual: Submitting the admin form with only Name="QA Minimal Product" and a short description created and published the product (empty full review, empty image URL, empty affiliate link, no specification rows, price $0). Re-editing it and saving price="-50" and affiliate link="not-a-valid-url" also saved successfully — the admin list now shows "-$50" for that product. Only a fully empty form is rejected ("Please fill in all required fields"); rating is bounded 0-5 solely by the native number input max attribute.

issue: No way to browse the complete featured set; homepage featured strip is capped at 3 and the "View all" featured link ignores the featured filter
actual: Marking/unmarking does update the strip (after creating featured "QA Zen Desk Lamp" and unfeaturing Sony, the homepage strip changed from Sony/Peloton/Dyson to Peloton/Dyson/QA Zen Desk Lamp). However the strip only ever shows 3 items: while 4 products were featured, the newly featured QA Zen Desk Lamp was hidden from the homepage. The section's "View all" link points to /products?featured=true, but that page ignores the parameter and renders "11 products found" (all products, featured and not), so visitors have no view of the complete featured collection.

evidence: Admin form category is a single-select with exactly Tech Gadgets/Home Goods/Fitness. Created "QA Zen Desk Lamp" with Home Goods → appears on /category/home (4 items) with badge "Home", and on its detail page category badge is Home; not present in tech/fitness listings.
Created "QA Zen Desk Lamp" with Tags field "qa-desk, qa-lighting"; detail page shows both tags as chips, and searching "QA-LIGHTING" on /products returns exactly that product ("1 product found").

issue: Admin changes are in-memory only and are lost on reload/revisit
actual: Created "QA Zen Desk Lamp" (Home Goods, featured) and "QA Minimal Product", unfeatured Sony, and changed Philips Hue tags — all visible in the running session. After reloading (navigating to http://localhost:6001/product/philips-hue-starter-kit) the app reset to the 9 seeded products: /products shows "9 products found" with no QA products, Philips Hue tags reverted to lighting/smart-home/ambiance/automation, and Sony is featured again. localStorage is empty (no persistence layer).

evidence: All 9 seeded products show exactly one category badge (Tech/Home/Fitness) and category counts sum 3+3+3=9. Admin form category is a single-value select offering only Tech Gadgets, Home Goods, Fitness; created product got exactly one (Home).

Edited Philips Hue tags from "lighting, smart-home, ambiance, automation" to "smart-home, qa-lighting-renamed, qa-fresh-tag" (kept one, renamed one, removed two, added one). Detail page shows exactly the 3 new tags; search "qa-fresh-tag" → 1 result (Philips Hue); search "ambiance" (removed tag) → "0 products found".

issue: Tag filter facet list is static (built from seed tags), not derived from current product tags
actual: After adding tag "qa-fresh-tag" (and "qa-lighting-renamed") to the existing Philips Hue Starter Kit — a change that is live, since keyword search "qa-fresh-tag" returns that product and its detail page lists the tag — the /products advanced tag filter still lists only the original 35 seed tags; "qa-fresh-tag" and "qa-lighting-renamed" are absent, so the new tag cannot be selected as a filter. Conversely removed tags remain selectable and now return nothing (selecting "ambiance" → "0 products found"). Same for tags on newly created products (qa-desk/qa-lighting were never offered).

evidence: Create (Home Goods): "QA Zen Desk Lamp" saved with name, price 129, rating 4.2, image URL, affiliate link, tags qa-desk/qa-lighting, 2 specs, review and featured=on; it appeared immediately on /products, /category/home and /product/qa-zen-desk-lamp with all values intact. Edit (Fitness): Theragun Pro → "Theragun Pro G5", $579, 4.8, new description — reflected instantly on /category/fitness.
